# SRD 5.1 data (test fixture)

A trimmed copy of files of [5e-bits/5e-database](https://github.com/5e-bits/5e-database) at
commit `a6212beb4b278917c2cff41c2b04c4ef4f3e0d6f` (`src/2014/en/`): the races dwarf, half-elf and
dragonborn, the subrace hill-dwarf, the traits they name, the Acolyte background and the monsters bandit, guard, werewolf (human form), wolf and adult red dragon, the classes fighter, rogue and wizard with their subclasses, levels and features, and the spells bless, cure wounds, detect magic, fire bolt, fireball, hold person, light, magic missile and sleep, and 25 items of the equipment (weapons, armor, thieves' tools, the burglar's pack and some of what it holds, a lute). The
`srd_import` test reads it.

This work includes material taken from the System Reference Document 5.1 ("SRD 5.1") by Wizards of
the Coast LLC and available at https://dnd.wizards.com/resources/systems-reference-document. The
